GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (17 May 46) LS
(SCAPIN 964)
APO 500
17 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated. 13 April 1946, file and subject as above, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one SHO, Hatori (Hitori) to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is hereby amended to delete said SHO's name. This name appears as the last name on page No. 2 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
